title: Visual awareness is mastery put to use in thought and planning

statements.text: For a creature or a machine to be visually aware of a feature, it must exercise mastery of the relevant sensorimotor contingencies and also make use of this exercise for thought, planning and speech. Without that use, behavior can be regulated by the contingencies with no awareness, as in an automatic pilot.

sources.quote: it must make use of this exercise for the purposes of thought and planning
